title: West Valley City, UT — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to West Valley City, UT: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

West Valley City is a city in UT with a population of 140,000. Utah’s second-largest city with the Maverik Center and a diverse community. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.3.
